name: Willow Lake Day Camp
description_short: Private day camp on 35 acres with a spring fed lake in Lake Hopatcong for pre-K through grade 8 plus CITs in grades 9 and 10, enrolled for four to eight weeks. Tuition includes bus transportation, lunch, snacks, trips and gear.
refund_policy_summary: $1,250 deposit and $400 non-refundable fee; deposit refundable or creditable until November 10, 2026, November installment until January 5, 2027, and nothing refundable after February 9, 2027. Weeks can be cut to a minimum of four by February 9 for a refund, or credited until May 1.
notes: Tuition by grade entering after summer: pre-K $7,550 to $9,675; grades K to 8 $7,550 (first or last 4 weeks) to $9,875 (all 8 weeks); CITs grades 9 and 10 $8,100. These are the posted Summer Saver prices, which the page says were valid through August 14, 2026. No camp Monday July 5, 2027. Units: Little Willows (pre-K and K), Middle Camp (grades 1 and 2), Senior Camp (3 to 8), CITs (9 and 10). All programs five days a week.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Session Dates and Tuition page: 2027 camp June 21 to August 13, all inclusive tuition with transportation and lunch, payment dates, location

source.title: Session Dates, Tuition, & Enrollment Application | Willow Lake Day Camp
